name: EXIF Remover
summary: Strip EXIF and other metadata from photos before sharing — all processing stays on your device.
description: Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP. We scan for EXIF and common metadata, then re-encode a clean copy without GPS, camera, or embedded tags. Nothing leaves your browser.

faqs.question: How does stripping work?
faqs.answer: Pixels are redrawn to a canvas and exported as a new file. Original metadata containers are not copied.

faqs.question: Will quality change?
faqs.answer: PNG stays lossless. JPEG/WebP use high-quality re-encode (~92%) which may differ slightly from the source.

faqs.question: Is the photo uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Detection and stripping run locally.
